get.summary: Read the authenticated Client's private draft and revision

200.description: Own draft, null if never created

post.summary: Save or clear a private draft with optimistic revision and idempotency
post.description: An empty text clears the draft but retains a revision tombstone. Identical event retries return the same acknowledgement; new writes must carry the current revision.

409.description: Stale draft revision or conflicting event

post.summary: Conditionally import one explicitly confirmed historical private draft
post.description: Requires no existing live or deleted draft, a matching published item revision and an accessible parent. The original timestamp is preserved. This endpoint does not delete local data.

409.description: Existing draft, stale item or conflicting event

post.summary: Conditionally import confirmed historical pending review plans
post.description: The Client comes exclusively from authentication. A new pending plan is accepted only for a current published item version and when no review or review-plan history exists for that Client and item. Checks, idempotency and writes are atomic. A completed local todo must not be represented as a completed review.

409.description: Review history exists, item revision changed, or event ID reused with different content

post.summary: Conditionally import explicitly confirmed historical private records
post.description: The authenticated Client is authoritative. New records require a published item at the specified revision and an unused record ID; parent records must already exist or precede their children in the same batch. The whole batch, timestamps, state and event deduplication commit atomically. This endpoint does not verify device-side ownership or delete device data.

400.description: Invalid record, position, parent or timestamp

409.description: Record already exists, item revision changed, or event ID reused with different content

post.summary: Create one confirmed source-specific historical personal collection atomically
post.description: The authenticated Client is authoritative. The caller must split cross-source members and attest historical ownership. Every member must be published; a live or deleted collection ID is never overwritten. Original order and timestamps are preserved. The endpoint never modifies a local collection.

404.description: A member is unavailable or unpublished

409.description: Collection exists or event ID reused with different input

post.summary: Apply an idempotent revision-checked personal collection command
post.description: Uses event_id scoped to the authenticated Client. Retry uncertain requests with the identical event_id and body. Commands never modify administrator catalogues.
